                                     View "public.v_cust"
 Column |       Type        | Collation | Nullable | Default | Storage  |     Description     
--------+-------------------+-----------+----------+---------+----------+---------------------
 id     | integer           |           |          |         | plain    | 
 email  | character varying |           |          |         | extended | view column comment
View definition:
 SELECT customers.id,
    customers.email
   FROM app.customers
  WHERE customers.score > 0::numeric
UNION ALL
 SELECT 0 AS id,
    'none'::character varying AS email;
Options: security_barrier=true
